blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Broadcast journalist Adrian “Golden Boy” Loterte was shot by unidentified gunmen in Daraga town in Albay on Monday afternoon, Oct. 12, prompting police to form a special investigation task group and intensify a manhunt. Loterte, an anchor of RBN News Television’s Rabas Cun Rabas and a resident of Barangay San Roque, was attending to his bakery at a rented shop in Purok 4 when one of two suspects allegedly fired multiple shots at him at about 4:10 p.m., according to Lt. Col. Maria Luisa Calubaquib, Bicol police spokesperson. He was rushed to the Daraga Doctors Hospital for treatment. […]... Keep on reading: Albay broadcaster shot; police hunt gunmen
